page_title: NIC 1-1 PSG | Nice v PSG 06/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) commits a foul and Jerome Brisard immediately signals a free kick.
90+5' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+4' A cross into the box from Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is cleared.
90+2' PSG keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' The current number of shots on goal is 3:9.
89' Vitinha (PSG) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Marcin Bulka is equal to it and makes an easy save.
89' PSG take a short corner kick.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Evann Guessand departs the field of play to be replaced by Badredine Bouanani (Nice).
87' Franck Haise has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pablo Rosario (Nice) replacing Tanguy Ndombele.
87' Bradley Barcola (PSG) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
87' A quickly taken corner by PSG.

87' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. PSG force their opponents to concede a corner.

85' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Marcin Bulka pulls off an easy save.
85' Kang-In Lee (PSG) works the corner short.
85' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Bradley Barcola (PSG). It will be a corner kick for PSG.
83' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ousmane Dembele (PSG). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
81' Youssoufa Moukoko (Nice) commits a rough foul. Jerome Brisard stops the game and makes a call.
80' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for PSG.
79' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Vitinha (PSG), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out of play. PSG are awarded a corner kick.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marco Asensio (PSG) comes onto the pitch for Fabian Ruiz.
77' Here comes a substitution. Mohamed-Ali Cho is given a rest as he is replaced by Sofiane Diop (Nice).
76' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Youssoufa Moukoko (Nice) replaces Jeremie Boga.
75' A pass travels right across the box to Vitinha (PSG) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Marcin Bulka denies him with a decent save.
74' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
71' Substitution. Warren Zaire-Emery did his best and is replaced by Vitinha (PSG).
71' A yellow card for a tackle by Hicham Boudaoui (Nice). Jerome Brisard doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
69' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) is adjudged offside.

65' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.

65' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Marcin Bulka has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
63' Nuno Mendes (PSG) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

62' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
62' Kang-In Lee (PSG) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
62' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play and PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
62' Kang-In Lee (PSG) takes a short corner kick.

61' Dante (Nice) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
61' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
60' Jeremie Boga (Nice) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Nice have a corner.
60' Nice quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
60' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Nice will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
59' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Marquinhos (PSG). Jerome Brisard saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
57' Problems for Franck Haise as Youssouf Ndayishimiye is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Antoine Mendy (Nice) replaces him.
54' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
54' Jeremie Boga (Nice) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
54' Marquinhos (PSG) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the right post.
53' PSG work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
52' 1 - 1 It's an own goal! Moise Bombito (Nice) scores into his own net!
52' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

51' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to PSG.
51' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
50' Dangerous play by Ali Abdi (Nice). Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
48' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball goes out for a corner. PSG can continue in their attacking effort.
48' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) steps up to send the ball in.
46' The referee allows time for a substitution. Randal Kolo Muani will be replaced by Kang-In Lee (PSG).
46' The whistle blows and Jerome Brisard starts the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' The foul by Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) was seen by Jerome Brisard who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
45' Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
43' 27:73 – the ratio of ball possession.
40' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
38' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Ali Abdi (Nice) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Gianluigi Donnarumma. He makes it 1:0.
38' The ball is out of play and Nice manage to earn a corner.
38' Jeremie Boga (Nice) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
38' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

37' A sweet pass finds Nuno Mendes (PSG) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. Marcin Bulka is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. PSG have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
36' Marquinhos (PSG) was probably a bit loose with his words to Jerome Brisard, who decides to show him a yellow.
36' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) uses the wrong choice of words while trying to explain something to the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
35' It looks like Dante (Nice) saw red with that tackle. Jerome Brisard won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
34' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
32' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
30' A cross from Ousmane Dembele (PSG) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
29' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
29' The resulting corner from Ousmane Dembele (PSG) is cleared by the defence.
28' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
27' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
27' Bradley Barcola (PSG) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Good work from PSG as they win a corner.
26' Nuno Mendes (PSG) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
24' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
23' The linesman signals that Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
22' Nice can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
21' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) heads on.
20' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' The game is interrupted now, Ali Abdi (Nice) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
15' Bradley Barcola (PSG) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
13' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) stoops for a header low near the left post from a cross, but the goalkeeper pulls off a great save!
10' Bradley Barcola (PSG) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
8' Half-chance! Jeremie Boga (Nice) plays a pass into the box, but Gianluigi Donnarumma reacts well to snuff out the attack.
6' Evann Guessand (Nice) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Mohamed-Ali Cho.
4' Evann Guessand (Nice) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
4' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! PSG will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jerome Brisard.
